QuestInfo.name: Following the Clues to Perion
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart has a suggestion for you. Go hear what he has to say.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart says you can't progress as a knight if you doubt yourself. 10 Boogies can help with that. To find her in Perion, go see #b#eKiru and Kiriru at the Sky Ferry#n#k.
QuestInfo.2: Neinheart says you can't progress as a knight if you doubt yourself. You can find out more from 10 Boogies, an informant in Perion.
QuestInfo.parent: Where in Maple World is Chromile the Knight?

0.0: You can't progress as a knight if you doubt yourself. Check out the info for yourself to dispel your doubts.

yes.0: Let me introduce you to someone that can help you finish this as quickly as possible. When you get to Perion, look for a girl named #b10 Boogies#k. She's still very green, but I'm sure she will be able to aid you.
yes.1: I've made arrangements for a boat to take you directly to Perion. It's waiting for you at the docks. Speak to #bKiriru and Kiru#k at the #bSky Ferry#k and you can be on your way.

no.0: Do you need time to think about this?

0.1: Go to Perion and find Chromile. You're still in training, but... You have to know who you are to succeed.

1.0: You have to be Chromile's kid! Welcome, so nice to meet you! They call me 10 Boogies for entirely classified reasons.

yes.0: I was told I should offer you some help, so that's what I'm gonna do!
